def strip_accents(text):
    """Strips accents from a piece of text."""
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFD", text)
    output = []
    for char in text:
      cat = unicodedata.category(char)
      if cat == "Mn":
        continue
      output.append(char)
    return "".join(output)

    try:

    except:
        args.input_arguments = None
